integrity: The analytical proof specifies the joint density for all regular widths. Numerical comparisons cover finite samples and quadrature only; no external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge Euclidean cube; same Haar normal for central section and width; no translated planes or general orthotopes; historical uniqueness not independently established; code supplements, rather than proves, the identities.
title: A three-phase conditional face-count law for random central sections of the cube
